data.content:
## [Sheets are horrible quality!](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a553288eb9a02b29d94556d)
I contacted Lulu and Georgia customer service and received no reply. I have had the Sarah Sherman Samuel tiger hemp sheet set for under a year and about 8 months in, they completely shredded. I have made many purchases from Lulu and Georgia — multiple rugs, wallpaper, etc and have always been incredibly impressed with the quality. However, these sheets are not it. For them to cost over $300 and be completely unusable less than a year into owning them is extremely disappointing. I have 10 year old sheets from Target that are better quality, which is not what I would not have expected from Lulu and Georgia. For the cost, I had expected to use them for years - not be in a position where I have to buy new sheets every 8 months. Given that Lulu and Georgia hasn’t even replied to my email, it makes it pretty clear they don’t care about the quality of materials that they sell and they obviously don’t care about resolving this issue. They have no reviews on their website, so I wanted to review here to warn people that their sheets are not good quality!! I’m out over $300 because of it. I should have just bought from a different company, since I’ve had better customer service with other companies.

May 4, 2026

Unprompted review
